articles.title: Fifa president Infantino will stand for re-election
articles.summary: Fifa president Gianni Infantino will stand for re-election in March, the world governing body has confirmed.

articles.title: Who will carry Rangers' goal threat after 'significant' Shankland injury?
articles.summary: Rangers captain Lawrence Shankland is set for a spell on the sidelines after picking up a "significant" hamstring injury in Saturday's Scottish Premiership victory over Motherwell.

articles.title: Infantino to stand for re-election as FIFA president
articles.summary: Gianni Infantino will stand for re-election as FIFA president next March.
